page.overview:
Who is Mindran?

Mindran was an ancient Sith Lord whose likeness was chiseled into the rock walls of the citadel on Exegol by When Supreme Leader of the First Order and Master of the Knights of Ren Kylo Ren arrived on Exegol to confront Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious, he moved through the Sith Citadel and recognized a number of statues of Sith Lords that were etched into the walls from his studies.

Of those he recognized were Locphet, Felkor, Sissiri, Naga Sadow, and Mindran. While there, Kylo Ren also heard their unintelligible whispers, along with the familiar voice of Sidious, which he had heard since childhood.

Mindran was first mentioned in Star Wars in the 2020 novel Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel, authored by Michael Kogge.
